variants.name: default
variants.what: one C3D8R, three static steps, strain increments 1e-5

variants.name: one_step
variants.what: single step, displacement history as tabular amplitude

variants.name: series_5
variants.what: NOT A NEGATIVE: five elements in series follow the homogeneous path (no imperfection, no localisation) and give the identical response

variants.name: no_damage
variants.what: no tension damage table: unloading with E0, no damage variable

variants.name: displacement_type
variants.what: stiffening and damage tables typed as DISPLACEMENT: the numbers are read as metres

variants.name: total_strain
variants.what: total strains entered where Abaqus expects cracking strains

variants.name: viscosity
variants.what: viscosity parameter 0.2 at a step time of 1

variants.name: unit_mpa
variants.what: tension stiffening stresses in MPa in a kPa model

variants.name: no_unload
variants.what: monotonic loading without the unloading branch

variants.name: fake_report
variants.what: correct ODB, unloading modulus reported as E0
